purpose: Give a mathematician an exact diagnosis of the remaining AJCR route, separating theorem gaps from downstream formal transport.
verdict: The route is not stalled by formal transport alone. The two producer statements below are the mathematical boundary: finite-stage Yoneda representability and exact-carrier orbit geometry over an arbitrary finite Galois stage.
review_route: translated charts over a separably closed field
Pic0 represented over the original field

established.statement: The good line-bundle locus and matching divisor locus are defined over arbitrary test schemes.
The evaluation divisor gives a natural two-sided inverse to the rank-one Abel map.
Translations of the rank-one chart cover Picard classes over a separably closed field.
A scheme and a representing universal Pic0 class exist over the separably closed field.
The pinned universal class has both chart-to-overlap restriction equalities and is packaged as Pic0FiniteStageUniversalAtlasClass.
gluingGluedIso and finiteStageBaseChangeIso compare the scalar-extended finite-stage glue with the separably-closed atlas glue as schemes.

current_strategy: finite affine charts and overlap maps for the separably-closed representer
one universal Picard class on P.gluedOver
natural equivalence between maps to P.gluedOver and Pic0 families
projectivity or orbit-affine control for P.gluedOver

issue_classification.exact_target: For every test scheme T over Spec k, produce a precomposition-natural equivalence between maps to P.gluedOver and pic0TypeFunctor C T; equivalently produce (pic0TypeFunctor ((baseChange K P.N.1).obj C)).RepresentableBy P.gluedOver with the exact carrier and no extra binder.
issue_classification.current_evidence: The glue package gives charts, overlaps, and a glued scheme. finiteStageBaseChangeIso and gluingGluedIso give an object-level scheme comparison after base change. Neither gives the natural homEquiv for arbitrary T. The roadmap explicitly records that no binder-free homEquiv producer exists.
issue_classification.mathematical_obstruction: A scheme isomorphism after scalar extension does not identify the finite-stage moduli functor unless the Pic0 functor itself is transported through that isomorphism for every test scheme.

issue_classification.exact_target: Turn the compatible chart and overlap classes into one class on the glued scheme, and prove that its pullback along every test map is the class corresponding to that map under the Yoneda equivalence.
issue_classification.current_evidence: The local universal class and both restriction equations are already explicit in Pic0FiniteStageUniversalClass.lean.
issue_classification.mathematical_obstruction: The remaining statement depends on the missing functor-level equivalence; local compatibility alone does not assert a global universal property.

issue_classification.exact_target: Prove FiniteInAffine P.glueData.glued, or an equivalent finite-dimensional projective-space immersion/projectivity statement, over the arbitrary finite Galois stage used by P.
issue_classification.current_evidence: Pic0FiniteStageOrbitAffine.lean supplies producers only after consuming rep and, by route, assuming an algebraically closed field plus connectedness/irreducibility or an explicit immersion/projectivity input. Stable-affine wrappers have the same dependency.
issue_classification.mathematical_obstruction: The finite-Galois quotient needs orbit affineness for the same carrier that represents Pic0. Existing conditional lemmas do not provide an unconditional arbitrary-field theorem before rep has been constructed.

issue_classification.exact_target: Apply the representation-preserving finite-Galois descent theorem to P.gluedOver, its semilinear action, exact-carrier orbit geometry, and the same universal class, retaining cocycle and naturality.
issue_classification.current_evidence: The reviewed blueprint already states the finite-Galois quotient and representation-preserving descent route.
issue_classification.mathematical_obstruction: The remaining issue is whether the hypotheses produced by the two preceding theorems match the descent theorem; no new moduli object should be introduced here.

issue_classification.exact_target: Pass the descended scheme and the same universal class unchanged through PicRepDatum, JacobianData, and the final Jacobian statement.
issue_classification.current_evidence: The Jacobian data file is downstream of the original-field RepresentableBy certificate.
issue_classification.mathematical_obstruction: Choosing a second representing scheme or a second universal class would change the route; otherwise this is packaging of the descended datum.

why_the_same_boundary_reappears: The current strategy keeps proving restriction, overlap, diagram, and base-change identities for the finite atlas. These establish a plausible carrier and compatible local classes, but not the assertion that for every T, maps(T, P.gluedOver) are naturally the same as Pic0-families on T. The orbit-affine producers then consume the missing rep rather than create it.
mathematical_conclusion: The route contains one confirmed functor-level theorem gap and one confirmed exact-carrier geometry gap. Class gluing, finite-Galois descent, and the Jacobian handoff are conditional downstream work. A route change is needed if either producer theorem requires a different carrier or extra hypotheses.
